intent.proves: An anonymous cart is created, a line added, shipping and payment set, and createOrder returns an order.

bindings.operation: POST /dwapi/ecommerce/carts/create, POST items, PATCH shipping and payment, POST createOrder
bindings.reason: Writes data on the host (creates a cart, order or token); the runner executes read-only checks only, so this stays planned until a sandboxed behavioural rule exists.
